title: ixeris denticulata
intro: Ixeris denticulata, commonly known as Chinese dandelion or dandelion chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Compositae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve liver function. The therapeutic actions of Ixeris denticulata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties, which have been shown to aid in the treatment of various diseases and conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ixeris denticulata include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
